tools.name: check_pdf_accessibility
tools.description: Check a PDF at a public URL for accessibility problems: WCAG 2.1 AA checks (tags, title, language, alt text on images, link text, tab order, scanned pages without text, form fields, fonts) plus the full PDF/UA-1 machine-checkable rule set via veraPDF. Returns a score, each failing check with page nu

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_pdf_accessibility · Private data: check_pdf_accessibility · Public sink: check_pdf_accessibility.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_pdf_accessibility · Private data: check_pdf_accessibility · Public sink: check_pdf_accessibility

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
